## Description and Rationale

I love data. I love flight data. This challenge seems appropriate.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Belgium

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(gt)

gt(tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~forename,   ~surname,  ~affiliation,
   1L,    "John", "Du Preez", "independent"
  )
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
```
